title: NorEval: A Norwegian Language Understanding and Generation Evaluation Benchmark

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing pairwise comparisons to measure how often an LLM acting as a judge favors its own generated outputs over those of other models.

Using language identification tools (GlotLID) to analyze if instruction-tuned models and LLM judges exhibit a preference for English or related Scandinavian languages instead of generating the requested Norwegian.
Evaluating response pairs twice with switched positions to measure if the LLM-as-a-judge prefers a response based purely on its presentation order (first vs. second).

Using the NorTruthfulQA dataset in multiple-choice and open-ended generative setups to evaluate whether models propagate false beliefs and stereotypes across categories like religion, politics, and demographic traits.
